literal_meaning: স্বপ্নেরও অগোচর (even beyond the reach of dreams)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই অর্থ উপার্জন করা স্বপ্নেরও অগোচর।
example_sentences_in_english: His wish is beyond even dreams.
Earning that much money is utterly impossible.
note: This idiom emphasizes the unattainability of desires, drawing from the metaphorical idea of dreams as the limit of imagination.
